items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Sort of like a Louis Armstrong–King Oliver type thing?

ctx.x: Yeah, asked my mom to let me play. He was excellent, but I really wouldn’t call him a jazz player. He was an excellent saxophone player, and he knew how to harmonize. I didn’t really know anything about that, because what he wanted me to do was second him, and I didn’t know how to do that.
Sort of like a Louis Armstrong–King Oliver type thing?
Yeah, where you play a third under, or whatever you chose, but you kept that line.
